## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Infrastructure/CI change

## Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Self-reviewed my code for obvious issues
- [ ] No `console.log` / `print()` statements left in
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, URLs, or credentials
- [ ] Error handling added where appropriate
- [ ] Type hints added (Python) / TypeScript types used

### Testing
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pytest` / `npm run build`)
- [ ] Edge cases considered and tested
- [ ] Load/performance impact considered

### Security
- [ ] No new security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] Input validation on any new user inputs
- [ ] Authentication/authorization checked
- [ ] No SQL injection, XSS, or CSRF risks
- [ ] Secrets not committed to repository

### Documentation
- [ ] Code comments added where logic isn't self-evident
- [ ] README updated if needed
- [ ] API documentation updated for new endpoints
